definitions.explanation: A large, elaborately decorated wheeled platform pulled or carried through the streets during Japanese festivals. Often features ornamental figures, lanterns, and sometimes musicians.

examples.japanese: {山車|だし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}り{歩|ある}く→練り歩く：13881_neriaruku⟧。
examples.english: The festival float parades through the streets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧な{山車|だし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何台|なんだい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: At the festival, many gorgeous floats were lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧{山車|だし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{引|ひ}き{回|まわ}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: At this area's festival, floats handed down from the Edo period are paraded around every year.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The kanji {山車|だし} is an irregular reading (ateji). The word {山車|だし} originally referred to something brought out (⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧) for display.

USAGE:
{山車|だし} are a central feature of many traditional Japanese festivals. Famous examples include the floats at the {祇園祭|ぎおんまつり} in Kyoto, the {高山祭|たかやままつり} in Gifu, and the {秩父|ちちぶ}{夜祭|よまつり} in Saitama. Some regions use different terms such as ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧ or {曳山|ひきやま} for similar festival floats.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山車|だし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to pull a float
- {山車|だし}⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧: float procession
- {山車|だし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to decorate a float
